text: Running totals that reset on a schedule — year-to-date, month-to-date, quarter-to-date. Some of the most requested numbers in business reporting, and DAX has a function built for each.
Broken out by month, March shows January plus February plus March combined — not just March's own total. Come January, it resets to zero and climbs again.
Same exact pattern, shorter cycles — one resets every month, the other every quarter.

Running a fiscal year that doesn't start in January? Pass the fiscal year's last day as an optional argument, and the whole year boundary shifts to match — July through June, or whatever your organization uses.
TOTALYTD is shorthand for CALCULATE plus DATESYTD. Next lesson, we use that combination directly — for the cases the shorthand can't quite reach.
